description: Versioned rule registry for canonicalizing static-analyzer diagnostics to CWE-401. A rule is counted only if it appears here with counts_for_cwe401=true and the warning is in the target scope. Tool versions are recorded per run; this file pins the mapping semantics, not the analyzer binary.

clang-sa.name: Clang Static Analyzer

severity_policy.note: clang-sa findings are emitted as warnings; high-only therefore equals the default for this tool.

clang-sa.notes: Existing formal Tier B baseline. Rule names follow Clang 22.x. New rule names require a registry version bump and a dev-set freeze before test evaluation.

clang-tidy.name: clang-tidy (clang-analyzer checks)

severity_policy.note: clang-analyzer checks are reported as warning diagnostics.

clang-tidy.notes: clang-tidy version 22.1.8 is available in the project WSL environment. The analyzer checks are a separate front end over the same Clang analysis engine as clang-sa, so a near-identical result is expected; report it as a front-end/tooling comparison, not as an independent algorithm.

gcc-analyzer.name: GCC -fanalyzer

severity_policy.note: GCC analyzer leak diagnostics are warnings carrying [CWE-401].

gcc-analyzer.notes: GCC 15.3.0 is available in the project WSL environment. Only -Wanalyzer-malloc-leak counts for CWE-401; other analyzer warnings are retained as diagnostics but do not set y_pred=1.

cppcheck.name: Cppcheck

severity_policy.note: Cppcheck memleak is severity=error; high-only is the Cppcheck default operating point for leak findings.

cppcheck.notes: Existing formal Tier B baseline. The binary is not system-installed in the project WSL image; the prior run used an unpacked Debian package under /tmp. A new run must record the exact binary/version and FILESDIR workaround.

infer.name: Infer

severity_policy.note: Infer issue severity is recorded as reported; verify before freezing.

infer.notes: Infer is not installed in the project WSL image. This entry is a documentation/registry stub; no result may be reported until a real run exists and records version/command.

codeql.name: CodeQL
codeql.command_template: codeql database create ... && codeql database analyze ... --format=sarif-latest

severity_policy.note: Both pinned queries report SARIF level=warning; high-only equals the default operating point for this run.

codeql.notes: CodeQL CLI 2.27.4 + codeql/cpp-queries 1.10.0 (cpp-all 12.4.0) are installed under ~/tools and ~/.codeql; a real 200-unit run exists at static_extended/runs/codeql_20261114_cwe401_full. Only the two pinned CWE-401 queries count; headers/out-of-scope findings do not. Rule names changed from the earlier stub (cpp/memory-leak) and require this registry version.
